lines.zh: 我在水中慢慢摆动身体。
lines.en: I sway slowly through the water.
The flaps along my sides part the water.
I glide forward near the seabed.
My long appendages sweep ahead of me.
I sink a little and rise again.

lines.zh: 刚毛拂过水草，我滤着走。
lines.en: Bristles brush the weeds as I filter along.
My segments flex one after another.
I ride the current forward.
My long body bends around a sunken stone.
The deep water is cool. I am comfortable.
As I roll, my shell scrapes the bottom.

lines.zh: 我在水底留下一道浅痕。
lines.en: I leave a faint trail on the bottom.
My feelers spread out in the water.

lines.zh: 我又往更深处去了一些。
lines.en: I go a little deeper still.
My tail end stirs the water gently.

lines.zh: 我从沙地上方缓缓掠过。
lines.en: I drift slowly over the sand.
I follow the undertow around a bend.

lines.zh: 我的身体在水里几乎透明。
lines.en: My body is nearly transparent in the water.
I hang in the water, utterly still.
The current moves my feelers.
I am filtering what the water holds.
My segments open slightly.
The seabed is dark and quiet.
I turn slowly toward the light.
Bubbles rise past me.
I wait for a current to come.

lines.zh: 我的壳上停了一层细沙。
lines.en: A film of fine sand has settled on my shell.

lines.zh: 这片静水，我滤了半辈子。
lines.en: I've filtered this still water half my life.
I stir my tail segments gently.
I am breathing, underwater.
There is light above. I do not go up.
I feel the weight of the water.
I let myself sink a little.

lines.zh: 我周身的须又理了一遍。
lines.en: I comb my feelers through again.
You are above the water; I am below.
I do not fear people; I simply swim off.
My feelers are for filter feeding.
You cannot see me well; I am very flat.
Now and then I leap from the surface.
I keep away from shallow water.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里慢慢滤过。
lines.en: I filter slowly through your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的节片在光里会发亮。
lines.en: My segments shine in the light.
No need to fear me. I do not bite.
I prefer deeper water.
If you put your hand in the water, I will hide.
My eggs must be laid underwater.
One of my segments has slipped out of line.

lines.zh: 我沉到沙面，刚毛扎进泥。
lines.en: I settle on the sand, bristles in the silt.
A few of my feelers are broken.

lines.zh: 甲壳朝下，我翻正了身子。
lines.en: Shell down, I right myself.
I slowly draw myself in.
My blood is pulled into a thread by the current.
I press against the stone and hold still.
I try to swim and drift slightly.
You interrupted my feeding.
A few bristles snapped — I can still swim.
Whatever is in the water, I will filter.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的东西漂着呢。
lines.en: What you scattered is drifting.
I turn slowly, feelers first.
Too little; I filter it in one pass.
The water is clouding. I do not like it.
I circle once before returning.
Drop things into the water gently.
My feelers have opened.
This is not enough to fill a seam.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游开了，只是看看。
lines.en: I drift away. I was only looking.
I open my feelers and come slowly nearer.

lines.zh: 你撒在水面上的散开了。
lines.en: What you scattered on the water has spread.

lines.zh: 我沿着水底去追那点味道。
lines.en: I follow that trace along the bottom.
I filtered twice and found little.

lines.zh: 水流把你的手往我这边带。
lines.en: The current draws your hand my way.
I circled once and came back.
The water pushes me aside slightly.
You touched my segmented back shell.
I do not resist; I only sink.
There is water between us.
My feelers got pushed crooked.
The current bends; my feelers tilt.
That stirred up a little sand.
I slide away with the current.
My segments tighten one by one.
I strain the water with my bristles.
I am looking for a good spot underwater.
The eggs must be laid in water.
We bury the eggs beneath fine sand.
The current will carry them.
Let us swim side by side a while.
My feelers touched yours.

lines.zh: 这片深水没有什么危险。
lines.en: This deep water holds little danger.
When the young hatch, they must be bucketed.
We swim slowly downward.
A little deeper, and quieter.
I sweep it toward me with my feelers.
It is very light in the water.

lines.zh: 刚毛滤食的嘴，压在沙上。
lines.en: This filter-feeding bristle mouth presses the sand.
It slid away on the current.
I try to swallow it and cannot.
This won't filter into my mouth.

lines.zh: 绕着它游一圈，看看是什么。
lines.en: I circle it once to see what it is.
It sank to the seabed.
I pinched it with a segment.

lines.zh: 留在沙子上面，闪得厉害。
lines.en: It stays on the sand, glinting.
What I fix on is the current.
You are blocking my way up.
I have no teeth — why would I chase you?
I only want to swim past.
My feelers are locating you.
Step back and the water clears.
It is safer in the deep water.
I sink into deeper water — no chase.
This sand is soft. I can burrow.

lines.zh: 我用刚毛把水里的食滤出来。
lines.en: I filter my food out of the water with bristles.
I sink along your shadow.
I circle in the water at your feet.

lines.zh: 水流把你的味道送下来。
lines.en: The current brings your scent down.
I withdraw deeper.

lines.zh: 你站的水面下有一道沙脊。
lines.en: There is a sand ridge under the water where you stand.
All my feelers point one way.
I settle slowly to the bottom.
If I keep still, I will not be seen.

lines.zh: 你弯腰看水里，我看见你了。
lines.en: You bent to look into the water. I saw you.
I go to the far side of the stone.

lines.zh: 我的头甲碰了你一下而已。
lines.en: My head shield merely bumped you.
My segments scraped your hand.
I leap up and fall back into the water.
A tail-flick splashes your face.
I turn and sink.
I did not mean to hurt you.

lines.zh: 我的须缠住了你的手指。
lines.en: My feelers tangled around your fingers.

lines.zh: 你把我推到滤食的口边。
lines.en: You shoved me onto my filter-feeding mouth.

lines.zh: 我落在沙上，扬起一点尘。
lines.en: I land on the sand and raise a little silt.
I only wanted to swim past.

lines.zh: 我这排刚毛，滤的是海水。
lines.en: These bristles filter seawater.

lines.zh: 沙地上方多了一片影子。
lines.en: There is one more shadow above the sand.
Fine sand still clings to my segments.
This water is deep enough. I will stay.
I slide out from the seagrass.
I test the current with my feelers.
The light on the seabed is faint.
I turn half around, slowly.
There is something here worth filtering.
I settle just above the sand.
There is a new stir in the water.
I spread myself out in the water.

lines.zh: 水里的火不常见，我躲开。
lines.en: Fire underwater is rare. I move away.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔回海底，节片一震。
lines.en: I fell back to the seabed and my segments jolted.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这次水太深了。
lines.en: I belong in water, but this water is too deep.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被推得很远。
lines.en: The blast tears the water and hurls me far.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的节片缝。
lines.en: Something pierced between my segments.
A strange force turns the water cold.

lines.zh: 水里没有可滤的东西了。
lines.en: There is nothing left to filter in the water.
Lightning strikes the surface and the water lights up.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，连水也没有了。
lines.en: I sink, and even the water is gone.
